articles.summary: Today, DICK'S Sporting Goods, Inc. (NYSE: DKS) announced a multi-year partnership with basketball star, Caitlin Clark , uniting one of the most influential athletes with one of the leading sports retailers to bring Clark's brand to fans across the world. The exclusive deal includes DICK'S and Foot Locker, marking the first time either company has signed an athlete as a brand partner. "DICK'S Sporting Goods was always a stop before the start of any sports season when I was growing up," said Clark. "Being the first ever brand partner for both them and Foot Locker is a really special full-circle moment. Both brands have deep roots in sport, basketball and sneaker culture, and have strong connections with fans in the U.S. and around the world." "We're excited to partner with Caitlin because we see the same opportunity to build on the energy around basketball and bring more people closer to the game through DICK'S and Foot Locker," said Ed Stack, Executive Chairman, DICK'S Sporting Goods,
articles.title: DICK'S Sporting Goods, Inc. Signs Caitlin Clark as First-Ever Brand Partner Across DICK'S and Foot Locker

articles.summary: DICK'S Sporting Goods, Inc. (NYSE: DKS) will announce results for the third quarter of fiscal 2026 before the market opens on Tuesday, November 24 th . A conference call to discuss the results will be held that day at 8:00 a.m. Eastern Time. The call is being webcast and can be accessed at DICK'S Sporting Goods' Investor Relations website at investors.dicks.com . To listen to the live call, please go to the website at least fifteen minutes early to register and download and install any necessary audio software. A playback of the call will be archived on the Company's website for approximately twelve months. About DICK'S Sporting Goods, Inc. DICK'S Sporting Goods creates confidence and excitement by inspiring, supporting and personally equipping all athletes to achieve their dreams. Founded in 1948 and headquartered in Pittsburgh, DICK'S is a leading omni-channel retailer and an iconic brand in sport and culture. articles.summary: Golf Galaxy is teeing off Black Friday with a new way for golfers to win big. Today, the retailer announced its first-ever "Pick a Tag. Win Some Swag." giveaway, taking place at all Golf Galaxy stores nationwide on November 27. Starting at store open, 7 a.m. local time, golfers who visit their local Golf Galaxy can randomly select an envelope to reveal an instant prize, with the first 30 participants guaranteed to win. Prizes range from golf balls, tees and gloves to gift cards, complimentary in-store services and more. One athlete at every Golf Galaxy location will also score the local grand prize: an exclusive swag bag valued over $500 packed with products from top golf brands and a unique Golf Galaxy in-store experience. In addition, one nationwide grand prize winner will receive the ultimate at-home golf setup, featuring a Garmin R50 Launch Monitor, a full TaylorMade bag set and a head-to-toe FootJoy wardrobe.
